# mahi ISA reference

<!-- GENERATED by sw/isa/check.py --update from sw/isa/mahi.toml. Do not edit; edit mahi.toml. -->

Version 0. 32-bit instructions; program counters, branch targets and data addresses count 32-bit
words. The version-0 table describes the hardware as built, quirks included; open design questions are listed at the end.

## Fields

| Field | Bits | Width |
|---|---|---|
| `op` | [31:26] | 6 |
| `rd` | [25:21] | 5 |
| `nzp` | [25:23] | 3 |
| `rs` | [20:16] | 5 |
| `rt` | [15:11] | 5 |
| `imm16` | [15:0] | 16 |
| `imm20` | [20:1] | 20 |

## Formats

| Format | Fields used |
|---|---|
| N | (none) |
| R3 | `rd`, `rs`, `rt` |
| R2 | `rd`, `rs` |
| C | `rs`, `rt` |
| I | `rd`, `imm16` |
| U | `rd`, `imm20` |
| M | `rd`, `rs`, `imm16` |
| S | `rd`, `rs` |
| B | `nzp`, `imm16` |
| J | `imm16` |

## Registers

32 registers `r0`..`r31` per thread, 32 bits. Writes to `r29`, `r30`, `r31` are discarded.

| Register | Alias | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `r29` | `bid` | block id (8-bit DCR-assigned block index, zero-extended) |
| `r30` | `nthr` | threads per block = THREADS_PER_BLOCK * NUM_WARPS |
| `r31` | `tid` | thread id within the block = warp * THREADS_PER_BLOCK + lane |

Condition codes `nzp` (per warp, reset to 0, written only by `CMP`): `n` = 4, `z` = 2, `p` = 1.

## Operand notation

`rd` destination; `rc` read and written (rd field); `rv` value to store (rd field, read only); `rs`, `rt` sources;
`imm` signed 16-bit; `uimm20` unsigned 20-bit; `target` program word address; `[rs+imm]` = rs + sext(imm16); `[rs]` = rs.

## Instructions

| Op | Mnemonic | Format | Syntax | Unit | Semantics |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | `NOP` | N | `NOP` | ctrl | nothing |
| 1 | `BR` | B | `BR{n,z,p} target  (or BR nzp, target)` | branch | if (nzp_reg & nzp) pc = target; lanes that disagree diverge (scheduler divergence stack, 4 deep) |
| 2 | `CMP` | C | `CMP rs, rt` | alu | nzp = {rs < rt, rs == rt, rs > rt}, unsigned, per warp from the issuing lanes |
| 3 | `ADD` | R3 | `ADD rd, rs, rt` | alu | rd = rs + rt |
| 4 | `SUB` | R3 | `SUB rd, rs, rt` | alu | rd = rs - rt |
| 5 | `MUL` | R3 | `MUL rd, rs, rt` | alu | rd = low32(rs * rt) |
| 6 | `DIV` | R3 | `DIV rd, rs, rt` | div | rd = rs / rt (unsigned); rt == 0 faults (cause 1) |
| 7 | `LDR` | M | `LDR rd, [rs+imm]` | lsu | rd = mem[rs + sext(imm16)] |
| 8 | `STR` | M | `STR rv, [rs+imm]` | lsu | mem[rs + sext(imm16)] = rv |
| 9 | `CONST` | I | `CONST rd, imm` | alu | rd = sext(imm16) |
| 10 | `SYNC` | N | `SYNC` | ctrl | block barrier: waits until every active warp of the block arrives; faults (cause 3) if the warp is diverged (L1) |
| 11 | `LDSH` | S | `LDSH rd, [rs]` | shmem | rd = shared[rs]; rs >= SHARED_MEM_SIZE faults (cause 2) |
| 12 | `STSH` | S | `STSH rv, [rs]` | shmem | shared[rs] = rv; rs >= SHARED_MEM_SIZE faults (cause 2) |
| 13 | `CALL` | J | `CALL target` | branch | push pc+1 on the warp's return stack (8 deep, wraps silently, L6); pc = target |
| 14 | `RET` | N | `RET` | branch | pc = pop return stack |
| 15 | `EXIT` | N | `EXIT` | ctrl | the issuing lanes finish; a diverged warp resumes the next group from its stack |
| 16 | `ATOM_ADD` | R3 | `ATOM_ADD rd, [rs], rt` | lsu | old = mem[rs]; mem[rs] = old + rt; rd = old (lanes serialised, order unspecified) |
| 17 | `AND` | R3 | `AND rd, rs, rt` | alu | rd = rs & rt |
| 18 | `OR` | R3 | `OR rd, rs, rt` | alu | rd = rs \| rt |
| 19 | `XOR` | R3 | `XOR rd, rs, rt` | alu | rd = rs ^ rt |
| 20 | `SHL` | R3 | `SHL rd, rs, rt` | alu | rd = rt < 32 ? rs << rt : 0 |
| 21 | `SHR` | R3 | `SHR rd, rs, rt` | alu | rd = rt < 32 ? rs >> rt : 0 (logical) |
| 22 | `MOD` | R3 | `MOD rd, rs, rt` | div | rd = rs % rt (unsigned); rt == 0 faults (cause 1) |
| 23 | `MIN` | R3 | `MIN rd, rs, rt` | alu | rd = signed_min(rs, rt) |
| 24 | `MAX` | R3 | `MAX rd, rs, rt` | alu | rd = signed_max(rs, rt) |
| 25 | `ABS` | R2 | `ABS rd, rs` | alu | rd = \|rs\| (signed; ABS(INT_MIN) = INT_MIN) |
| 26 | `NEG` | R2 | `NEG rd, rs` | alu | rd = -rs |
| 27 | `MAC` | R3 | `MAC rc, rs, rt` | alu | rc = low32(rc + rs * rt) |
| 28 | `ATOM_CAS` | R3 | `ATOM_CAS rc, [rs], rt` | lsu | old = mem[rs]; if old == rc: mem[rs] = rt; rc = old (untested, L9) |
| 29 | `LUI` | U | `LUI rd, uimm20` | alu | rd = uimm20 << 12 |
| 30 | `POPCNT` | R2 | `POPCNT rd, rs` | alu | rd = number of set bits in rs |
| 31 | `CLZ` | R2 | `CLZ rd, rs` | alu | rd = leading zeros of rs (32 for 0) |
| 32 | `BREV` | R2 | `BREV rd, rs` | alu | rd = bit-reverse(rs) |
| 33 | `FADD` | R3 | `FADD rd, rs, rt` | fp | rd = rs + rt (fp32) |
| 34 | `FSUB` | R3 | `FSUB rd, rs, rt` | fp | rd = rs - rt (fp32) |
| 35 | `FMUL` | R3 | `FMUL rd, rs, rt` | fp | rd = rs * rt (fp32) |
| 36 | `FMA` | R3 | `FMA rc, rs, rt` | fp | rc = rs * rt + rc (fp32, single truncation) |

Accepted older operand forms (assembler/assembler.py syntax):

- `LDR`: `LDR rd, rs, imm`
- `STR`: `STR rv, rs, imm`
- `LDSH`: `LDSH rd, rs`; `LDSH rd, rs, 0`
- `STSH`: `STSH rv, rs`; `STSH rv, rs, 0`
- `ATOM_ADD`: `ATOM_ADD rd, rs, rt`
- `ATOM_CAS`: `ATOM_CAS rc, rs, rt`

## Pseudo-instructions

| Pseudo | Expansion |
|---|---|
| `MOV rd, rs` | `OR rd, rs, rs` |
| `JMP target` | `CMP r0, r0`; `BR z, target` (clobbers nzp; CMP of a register with itself always sets z) |
| `LI rd, imm32` | one CONST if the value fits a signed 16-bit immediate, one LUI if its low 12 bits are zero, otherwise an error (no OR-immediate to combine them without a scratch register) |

## Open questions before version 1

| ID | Topic | Question |
|---|---|---|
| Q1 | reconvergence | No join-point reconvergence; SYNC after divergence faults (L1). Pick: compiler-placed join instruction, or hardware post-dominator stack. |
| Q2 | addressing | Word addressing only, no byte/halfword access. Keep (backend scales pointers, i8/i16 by shift and mask) or move to byte addresses. |
| Q3 | kernel ABI | No kernel-argument mechanism, no stack pointer or private memory, hardware-only 8-deep return stack, 8-bit thread count. |
| Q4 | compare and branch | CMP is unsigned only, nzp resets to 0 so an unconditional branch needs a CMP first (L5). Signed compare and a true jump are cheap to add. |
| Q5 | immediates | No ALU-immediate forms; 32-bit constants need LUI + CONST + OR with a scratch register. |
| Q6 | floating point | FP32 add/sub/mul/fma only, not IEEE; no compare, min/max, conversion, divide or sqrt (L8). |
